# Nova Widget Mini

## Overview
The [Nova Widget](./nova-widget.md) Mini is a cost-effective variant of the Nova Widget device, specifically designed and targeted for hobbyists. It provides essential sensing capabilities in a compact form factor.

## Key Details
- **[Hardware](./hardware.md) Components:** Equipped with an nRF52840 microcontroller, powered by a CR2032 coin cell battery, and includes a capacitive soil probe.
- **[Firmware](./firmware.md) Configuration:** Ships with [MeshSync](./meshsync.md) enabled by default using a 15-minute reporting interval. Over-the-air (OTA) updates are deferred.
